cases.sentence: Вначале было ___, и Оно было с Богом.
cases.translation: In the beginning was the Word, and it was with God.
cases.explain: Слово is the subject of the verb было (was), so it is in the nominative case.

cases.translation: It was in the beginning with God.
cases.explain: The preposition у (by, with) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Предводители иудеев послали к ___ священников и левитов.
cases.translation: The leaders of the Jews sent priests and Levites to John.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to, toward) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Он нашел ___ и сказал ему, «Следуй за мной».
cases.translation: He found Philip and said to him, 'Follow me.'
cases.explain: Филиппа is the direct object of нашел (found); for an animate masculine noun the accusative equals the genitive form.

cases.sentence: Я крещу ___, но среди вас стоит тот, кого вы не знаете.
cases.translation: I baptize with water, but among you stands one you do not know.
cases.explain: Водой shows the means by which John baptizes, so it takes the instrumental case.

cases.translation: He came to testify about the light.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about) governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Вначале было Слово, и Слово было с Богом, и Слово было Богом.
reading.question: How does this Gospel begin?
options: "In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God"
"In the beginning God created the heavens"
"There once was a man named John"
reading.correct: "In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God"
reading.explain: The opening line proclaims the Word was in the beginning, with God, and was God.

reading.ru: Свет светит во тьме, и тьма не поглотила его.
reading.question: What is said about the light and the darkness?
options: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it
The light and darkness merged together
There was no light mentioned at all
reading.correct: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it
reading.explain: The text says the light shines in darkness and the darkness did not overcome it.

reading.ru: Богом был послан человек по имени Иоанн.
reading.question: Who was sent by God as a witness to the light?
reading.explain: A man named John was sent from God to testify about the light.

reading.ru: Слово стало человеком и жило среди нас.
reading.question: What happened to the Word, according to the text?
options: The Word became flesh and lived among us
The Word remained hidden in heaven
The Word became a written book
reading.correct: The Word became flesh and lived among us
reading.explain: The text states the Word became human and lived among people.

reading.ru: Ведь через Моисея был дан закон, а благодать и истина пришли через Иисуса Христа.
reading.question: What contrast does the text draw between Moses and Jesus Christ?
options: The law came through Moses, but grace and truth came through Jesus Christ
Moses gave grace, Jesus gave the law
Both gave exactly the same law
reading.correct: The law came through Moses, but grace and truth came through Jesus Christ
reading.explain: The text contrasts the law given through Moses with grace and truth through Jesus Christ.

reading.question: How did John respond when asked if he was the Christ?
reading.explain: John plainly declared, 'I am not the Christ.'

reading.ru: «Я голос, который раздается в пустыне. Выпрямите путь для Господа».
reading.question: How did John describe himself, quoting the prophet Isaiah?
options: As a voice crying in the wilderness to prepare the way for the Lord
As a priest serving in the temple
reading.correct: As a voice crying in the wilderness to prepare the way for the Lord
reading.explain: John quoted Isaiah, calling himself the voice crying in the wilderness.

reading.ru: Вот Божий ягненок, который заберет грех мира.
reading.question: What did John call Jesus when he saw him approaching?
options: The Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world
reading.correct: The Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world
reading.explain: John declared Jesus to be the Lamb of God who takes away the world's sin.

reading.ru: Я видел, как дух спускался на него с небес в образе голубя, и как он остался на нем.
reading.question: What sign did John see confirming Jesus's identity?
options: The Spirit descending from heaven like a dove and remaining on him
A voice from heaven naming him king
A star appearing over his head
Fire coming down from the sky
reading.correct: The Spirit descending from heaven like a dove and remaining on him
reading.explain: John testified he saw the Spirit descend like a dove and remain on Jesus.

reading.ru: Мы нашли Мессию, это значит помазанник», и привел его к Иисусу.
reading.question: What did Andrew tell his brother Simon after meeting Jesus?
options: "We have found the King of Egypt"
reading.explain: Andrew told Simon they had found the Messiah and brought him to Jesus.

reading.ru: Разве из Назарета может быть что-нибудь доброе?
reading.question: What skeptical question did Nathanael ask about Jesus?
options: "Can anything good come out of Nazareth?"
reading.correct: "Can anything good come out of Nazareth?"
reading.explain: Nathanael doubted, asking if anything good could come from Nazareth.
